audience: Orang yang baru mulai menata dokumen untuk sebuah proses layanan
single_message: Persiapan data yang rapi membantu pembaca memahami langkah awal sebuah proses.

source_context.brief: Draft edukasi awal; semua pernyataan teknis atau regulasi harus ditautkan ke sumber sebelum approval.

source_packet.objective: Help a first-time reader prepare the right information before starting a service process.
source_packet.audience_situation: The reader is unsure which information is actually needed and worries that corrections will restart the process.
source_packet.observation: People keep the source of a changed name, location, or document in separate places, so they cannot explain the latest version.

proofs.summary: Informasi yang tidak konsisten membuat sumber dan versi sulit ditelusuri.
proofs.content: Kelompokkan informasi yang berubah agar koreksi mudah ditemukan.

proofs.summary: Checklist data utama membantu pembaca membandingkan nama, lokasi, dan dokumen.
proofs.content: Bandingkan data utama dan tandai bagian yang masih membutuhkan sumber.

hooks: Mulai Proses dari Data yang Rapi

creative_brief.audience_situation: A first-time reader is preparing a service process and cannot tell which records need a source.
creative_brief.tension: The reader wants to move forward, but scattered records make every correction feel like a restart.
creative_brief.takeaway: A small source trail makes the next correction easier to locate.
creative_brief.point_of_view: Show the reader how to make a process traceable instead of promising a faster outcome.
creative_brief.desired_action: Save the guide and create one source note before starting.

routes.strategic_idea: Start with the moment a correction becomes hard to trace.
routes.audience_tension: The reader cannot tell which version of a record is current.
routes.message_promise: A short source note keeps the next correction findable.
routes.visual_premise: A single document trail moves from scattered notes to one marked source.
routes.distinctive_move: Use a visible red thread connecting each change to its source.
routes.risk: The thread could become decorative if labels are missing.
routes.why_different_from_recent_posts: Uses an annotated field note and a causal trail instead of the recent stacked checklist.

routes.strategic_idea: Show the same record before and after a source label is added.
routes.audience_tension: The reader has information but cannot explain why one version should be trusted.
routes.message_promise: One source label makes a correction easier to verify.
routes.visual_premise: A split-screen comparison with editable labels and one highlighted change.
routes.distinctive_move: Freeze one changed field in a before/after comparison.
routes.risk: The comparison must not imply a guaranteed process result.
routes.why_different_from_recent_posts: Uses a before/after proof frame and a single changed field, not a list of steps.

routes.strategic_idea: Correct the assumption that every record belongs in one undifferentiated folder.
routes.audience_tension: The reader saves everything together and loses the reason each item matters.
routes.message_promise: Separate requested records from supporting evidence before the first review.
routes.visual_premise: Two labeled trays sort records by their role in the process.
routes.distinctive_move: Turn the page into two physical trays with a deliberate handoff between them.
routes.risk: The tray labels must remain literal at thumbnail size.
routes.why_different_from_recent_posts: Uses a myth-to-sort interaction and physical trays instead of a document checklist.

human_selected_route.reason: The causal source trail matches the audience's correction problem and keeps the CTA singular.

art_direction.visual_premise: A single document trail moves from scattered notes to one marked source.
art_direction.distinctive_move: Use a visible red thread connecting each change to its source.
art_direction.rationale: The red thread makes traceability visible without adding an unrelated decorative motif.

decorative_elements.semantic_role: connects a changed field to its evidence
decorative_elements.rationale: The line explains the relationship and is not filler.

slides.headline: Mulai Proses dari Data yang Rapi
slides.visual_direction: Headline besar pada reading surface terang; satu ilustrasi dokumen; footer identitas tetap.
slides.accessibility_note: Pastikan headline kontras tinggi dan tidak bertumpuk dengan ilustrasi.

slides.headline: Kenapa Persiapan Data Penting?
slides.body: Informasi yang tidak konsisten membuat pembaca sulit mengetahui data mana yang perlu dicek lebih dulu.
slides.visual_direction: Dua kolom sederhana: data terpencar dan data terstruktur; tanpa foto dekoratif.
slides.accessibility_note: Gunakan label teks selain perbedaan warna.

slides.headline: Susun Informasi Dasar
slides.body: Kelompokkan data pemilik, lokasi, dan dokumen yang memang diminta pada proses yang berlaku.
slides.visual_direction: Tiga kartu bernomor dengan ikon dari satu keluarga visual.
slides.accessibility_note: Nomor dan judul kartu menentukan urutan baca.

slides.headline: Cek Sebelum Diajukan
slides.body: Bandingkan kembali nama, lokasi, dan data utama. Tandai bagian yang masih membutuhkan sumber atau konfirmasi.
slides.visual_direction: Checklist ringkas dengan satu tanda per baris dan ruang putih yang cukup.
slides.accessibility_note: Setiap status memiliki kata, bukan tanda warna saja.

slides.headline: Buat Proses Lebih Mudah Ditelusuri
slides.body: Simpan catatan sumber dan perubahan agar koreksi tidak dimulai dari awal.
slides.visual_direction: Satu CTA pada kartu merah, tanpa elemen promosi kedua.
slides.accessibility_note: CTA berbentuk teks jelas dengan kontras tinggi.

caption.hook: Sebuah proses sebaiknya tidak dimulai dari menebak dokumen.
caption.body: Susun dulu informasi pemilik, lokasi, dan data utama yang relevan. Lalu cek konsistensinya dan tandai bagian yang masih membutuhkan sumber resmi atau konfirmasi. Cara ini membuat proses lebih mudah ditelusuri ketika ada koreksi.

alt_text: Carousel dengan lima langkah ringkas untuk menata data sebelum memulai sebuah proses, menggunakan kartu checklist dan satu ajakan untuk menyimpan panduan.
